moisture_pct.quote: The freshly formed blocks ... contained about 45.35% moisture, 25.3% protein, and 25.4% fat, with a pH of 5.25.

fat_pct.quote: The freshly formed blocks ... contained about 45.35% moisture, 25.3% protein, and 25.4% fat, with a pH of 5.25.

salt_pct.quote: After 12 mo ... contained about 33.6% moisture, 29.2% protein, 30.0% fat, and 4.4% salt with a pH of 5.54

ph.quote: The freshly formed blocks ... contained about 45.35% moisture, 25.3% protein, and 25.4% fat, with a pH of 5.25.

ammonia.reason: 0.55-0.62 mg/g ammonia from amino-acid deamination/deamidation during 3-7 mo aging, low vs surface-ripened cheese.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole from tyrosine/tryptophan catabolism plus raw-milk native-pasture microflora.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from alpha-s1 casein by rennet/plasmin plus high salt 3.7% enhancing bitterness.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation, mold=none, no blue ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose and lysine at low moisture under high heat, typical pasta-filata pizza browning.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by Streptococcus thermophilus/Lactobacillus in high-fat matrix.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: High butanoic 68-246 mg/100g and hexanoic 22-57 mg/100g from kid/lamb rennet-paste pregastric lipase lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: 28-30% fat, 45% fat-in-dry-matter gives mouth-coating but dense stretched paracasein network limits cream.

crumbliness.reason: Hot-water plasticized fibrous oriented protein fractures short only when well-aged, not crumbly.

firmness.reason: Moisture ~36% plus dense stretched paste and 6-mo drying with pH 5.3 calcium-phosphate crosslinking.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde from phenylalanine Strecker degradation detected by GC-olfactometry, low concentration.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butyrate/hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol by nonstarter LAB esterases.

goaty.reason: C6/C8 medium-chain fatty acids give goaty-soapy notes though cow milk, released by rennet lipase.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes 2-/3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine catabolism plus proteolysis during 4-7 mo aging.

melt.reason: pH 5.3 demineralized paracasein flows on heating, moderate vs fresh mozzarella due to aged crosslinking.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-one from linoleic acid oxidation via lipoxygenase, GC-olfactometry mushroom note only.

oil_off.reason: Coalesced fat pools from stretching plus lipolysis release free oil on heating at 30% fat.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked cheese, smoked=false, no guaiacol/phenol wood-smoke compounds.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid pH 5.2-5.4 plus acetic acid dirty-sock note from thermophilic starter fermentation.

stretch.reason: Hot-water kneading aligns paracasein fibers retaining stringing/curd-pull when melted, defining filata.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Trace methional/dimethyl disulfide-tetrasulfide from methionine catabolism; hot stretching drives off H2S.

sweet.reason: Low residual lactose/galactose, slight glycerol and amino-acid sweetness masked by acid and 3.7% salt.

umami.reason: ~20 mg/g free amino acids including glutamate from rennet/plasmin/LAB peptidase proteolysis.
